overview: An immersive, dark-themed interactive website that simulates a world without algorithms — featuring random social feeds, shopping, music generation, a decision game, and a thought-provoking insight section.
features: Animated hero with procedural particle background
Randomized social media feed that reshuffles on every reload
Random shopping section with 'Show Something Else' button
Procedural music generator with genre, artist, and song randomization
Insight section on algorithms and daily life
Glitch effects, neon accents, and smooth micro-interactions
